test_cases.title: Order paid by card only is refunded to the same card
Order paid entirely by gift card is refunded as a new gift card
test_cases.preconditions: Order €80.00 paid entirely by gift card

test_cases.title: Split payment full refund
test_cases.expected: €50.00 as a new gift card, €100.00 to the Mastercard

test_cases.title: Original card expired: refund goes to store credit
test_cases.preconditions: Card used for the order has expired
test_cases.expected: Refund issued as store credit; customer is notified

test_cases.title: Payment provider failure: refund stays Failed and can be retried
test_cases.expected: Status Failed; retry possible; no money moved

test_cases.title: Confirmation shows a breakdown per payment method
Split amounts are rounded to the cent and add up to the refund total
test_cases.expected: Amounts per method have 2 decimals and add up to €99.99

test_cases.title: Refund cannot exceed the amount paid
Refund writes an audit log entry
test_cases.expected: Entry with amounts per payment method
